name: Gym Automation - Signup, Reminder, Weekly Report

parameters.content:
## Gym Automation

**Google Sheet** (tab name: `Members`) columns, exact spelling:
Name | Phone | Plan | Fee | Join Date | Expiry | Status

**Setup:**
1. Har Google Sheets node mein apna credential + Sheet ID select karo
2. Har WhatsApp node mein WhatsApp Business Cloud credential + Phone Number ID daalo
3. 'WhatsApp Report to Owner' mein OWNER_PHONE apna number (92300XXXXXXX) se replace karo
4. Workflow activate karo

**Note:** Meta ke rules ke mutabiq business-initiated messages ke liye approved template chahiye. Testing mein sirf verified numbers par jata hai.

parameters.formDescription: Join karne ke liye apni details bharein.

Aapki gym membership {{ $json.daysLeft === 0 ? 'aaj' : $json.daysLeft + ' din mein' }} expire ho rahi hai ({{ $json.expiry }}).
